page_note: 这一页是《Industry outlook 2025》第26页，上方为两栏正文，中部为一张无编号的折线图（全球消费支出指数，2020=100，六条曲线以引线标注），下方为“What to watch”栏目文字。

heading.title: Consumer spending on household goods & furniture will be sluggish
heading.subtitle: Global consumer spending in US$, 2020=100

components.evidence: "Hotels & restaurants", "Clothing & footwear" etc. written in the plot with curved arrows to each line; no legend
one line drawn in red with its label "Household goods & services" bold red, others grey
the only value axis, 100 to 180, is printed down the right edge of the plot
lowest tick printed is 100, no break glyph on the axis
grey vertical tint from 2024 to 2025 marking the forecast window
horizontal rules at each 10-unit tick across the panel, no vertical rules
heading line reads "Global consumer spending in US$, 2020=100"
axis shows bare 100...180; scale only in "Global consumer spending in US$, 2020=100"
"Source: EIU." and "Copyright © The Economist Intelligence Unit 2024. All rights reserved." in small print
six curved arrows drawn over the plot area running from each text label to its line
ticks 2020...2025 while the curves are smoothed, so intermediate points sit between ticks

new_components.name: source_beside_plot
new_components.evidence: "Source: EIU." and the copyright sit in the left side column level with the plot, not below it
new_components.why_it_matters: 来源与版权行不在图下方而在左侧栏，解析器可能把它们并入正文，导致表格失去来源归属。

new_components.name: curved_leader_arrow_labels
new_components.evidence: labels sit far from their lines and are attached by long curved arrows crossing other lines
new_components.why_it_matters: 系列名与曲线的对应只能靠弯箭头判断，取值时容易把某年数值归到错误的系列。

new_components.name: series_converge_at_index_base
new_components.evidence: all six lines start from one common point at 2020 on the 100 gridline
new_components.why_it_matters: 2020=100 这一数值同时属于六个系列，无法用“系列+年份”唯一定位。

new_components.name: heading_in_side_column
new_components.evidence: title and unit line occupy a narrow left column level with the plot, plot fills the right two-thirds
new_components.why_it_matters: 标题不在图上方，导出的 markdown 中标题与表格可能被分离，读值缺少上下文。

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数字，唯一的刻度在右侧、每格10个指数点（约35像素），必须靠像素插值。真正卡住的是：除 Hotels & restaurants（156/178）外，其余五条灰线在2024-2025年全部挤在120-140这20点区间内，而5%容差在125处约为±6点，相邻两条线（如124与125、128与132）的间距小于容差，读出的数值可以“对”但归属可能错；再加上没有图例、只靠弯箭头引线区分系列，2020年六条线又共汇于100，使“系列+年份”这一组键无法把单个数值唯一钉住。
